column4: cleat#2370: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so the postgres and mssql subtests' testutil.TestDB calls skip, and the sharded subtest (Postgres-only, ShardedStore has no SQL of its own) skips too since it also needs CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES/CLEAT_TEST_DB. Specific (contains "Test"), so it claims its own matches before the broad /postgres$ and /mssql$ lines in multi-db-ci-initial-measurement.tsv see them -- no bump needed there (cleat#2729's overlap resolution). Note: "sharded" matches neither /postgres$ nor /mssql$ nor /mysql$, so it is invisible to those broad lines either way -- it needs its own line regardless.
cleat#2370: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the postgres and mysql subtests skip, plus the Postgres-only sharded subtest. Same reasoning as the multi-db/mysql line above.

cleat#2370: the cluster job sets only CLEAT_TEST_DB (postgres), so the mysql and mssql subtests skip. The sharded subtest needs only postgres, which this job has, so it RUNS here and is not part of this line.

identical regex to the cluster line above, required by check-skips.sh so the scheduled engine-race.yml (postgres-only, same job-key) has its own pairing rather than relying on the per-PR cluster job alone.
